qa_pairs.question: How can users modify or resubmit a previously run job using Open Composer in Open OnDemand?
qa_pairs.answer: To modify or resubmit a previously run job in Open Composer, click on the job script under the 'Script Name' column, then select 'Load Parameters'. This will take you back to the job submission page where further modifications can be made before resubmitting the job.

qa_pairs.question: How do users monitor the status of their active jobs in the queue through the Open OnDemand interface?
qa_pairs.answer: To monitor jobs, users should navigate to the 'Jobs' tab and select 'Active Jobs'. They can filter jobs using the text box, sort columns by clicking on the headers (e.g., job status), and click on '>' next to a job for more details like start/end time and node list. To view all jobs in the queue, select 'All Jobs' from the drop-down menu at the top right.

qa_pairs.question: How do users access a web-based terminal for Trillium through the Open OnDemand service?
qa_pairs.answer: To access a web-based terminal for Trillium, users need to navigate to the 'Clusters' tab and select 'Trillium Shell Access'. This action will open a new browser tab with a terminal window, providing command-line interface access to Trillium.
